label: RUNX1::MECOM

sections.text: RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis.
MECOM encodes EVI1/MDS1-associated transcriptional regulators of hematopoiesis.

The t(3;21) fusion combines RUNX1 DNA-binding sequences with MECOM/EVI1 transcriptional-regulatory sequences, disrupting hematopoietic differentiation. It occurs in myeloid neoplasia, including therapy-related disease and CML blast phase.
MECOM-rearranged AML is assigned adverse genetic risk under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria.
